PayButton.note: the type=pay variants of button / regular, no standalone set

Switch.note: no standalone set: drawn only inside cell / regular

SegmentedControl.note: no standalone set: drawn only inside cell / regular

Icon.note: a page of one component per icon, not a component set

spacing.note: a page of spacer components, no Figma variables

radius.note: no page or variables in Figma; radii appear only as text in the spec frames

tokens.name: content-content-primary
tokens.usage: Default text and icons on background-bg-background and background-bg-surface: 12:1 light, 10:1 dark.

tokens.name: content-content-secondary
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata, input labels and placeholders on background-bg-surface (4.6:1 light, 4.6:1 dark). On background-bg-background it is 4.3:1 and on background-bg-subtle 4.1:1 in light, under 4.5:1: keep secondary text on surface.

tokens.name: content-content-disabled
tokens.usage: Text and icons of disabled controls only. Deliberately low contrast; never for readable content.

tokens.name: content-content-link
tokens.usage: Inline links and text buttons. 3.4:1 on background-bg-surface in light (under 4.5:1 for body text, a source value kept as is); 4.5:1 on dark surface.

tokens.name: content-content-accent
tokens.usage: Accent icons, selected states, focus caret in text fields. Same contrast as content-content-link: fine for icons and 3:1 marks, short of 4.5:1 for small text in light.

tokens.name: content-content-primary-cta
tokens.usage: Label on background-bg-primary-cta. White on brand blue is 3.4:1, under 4.5:1 for the 17px label: a source pair kept as is, flagged.

tokens.name: content-content-secondary-cta
tokens.usage: Label on background-bg-secondary-cta (10.7:1 light).

tokens.name: content-content-primary-invert
tokens.usage: Text on background-bg-background-invert and on brand-coloured surfaces.

tokens.name: content-content-secondary-invert
tokens.usage: Secondary text on background-bg-background-invert and on brand-coloured surfaces.

tokens.name: content-content-negative
tokens.usage: Error text and icons: field error messages, failed toasts. 4.5:1 on light surface; 3.4:1 on dark surface, so pair it with an icon there.

tokens.name: content-content-warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons. 3.5:1 on light surface (under 4.5:1): use for icons and 16px+ semibold labels, always with an icon.

tokens.name: content-content-positive
tokens.usage: Success icons and marks. 2.1:1 on light surface: never as the only carrier of meaning or for text; always with an icon or word in content-content-primary.

tokens.name: background-bg-background
tokens.usage: Page/screen background behind everything.

tokens.name: background-bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, grouped list sections, text fields, sheets — anything that sits on background-bg-background.

tokens.name: background-bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet fills inside a surface (search field, inactive segments). In dark it equals background-bg-background, so on a dark page it disappears: separate it with border-border-regular.

tokens.name: background-bg-info
tokens.usage: Neutral info blocks and notices.

tokens.name: background-bg-accent
tokens.usage: Solid accent fills: selected switch track, badges, progress fill.

tokens.name: background-bg-accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted accent fill: selected cell, accent chip, info highlight.

tokens.name: background-bg-accent-home
tokens.usage: Blue header area of the Home screen; dims to the muted blue in dark.

tokens.name: background-bg-primary-cta
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. One primary button per screen.

tokens.name: background-bg-secondary-cta
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill, with content-content-secondary-cta on it.

tokens.name: background-bg-disabled
tokens.usage: Fill of disabled buttons and inputs, with content-content-disabled on it.

tokens.name: background-bg-background-invert
tokens.usage: Inverted dark surfaces (dark toast, tooltip). Stays near-black in both themes.

tokens.name: background-bg-surface-invert
tokens.usage: Inverted light surface. Stays white in both themes.

tokens.name: background-bg-subtle-invert
tokens.usage: Quiet fill on brand-coloured or inverted surfaces (e.g. buttons on the blue Home header).

tokens.name: background-bg-negative
tokens.usage: Solid error fill: destructive button, error badge. White on it is 4.5:1.

tokens.name: background-bg-warning
tokens.usage: Solid warning fill: warning badge. White on it is 3.5:1, so keep labels 16px+ semibold.

tokens.name: background-bg-positive
tokens.usage: Solid success fill: status dot, success badge. White on it is 2.1:1 — no text on it.

tokens.name: background-bg-quick-access
tokens.usage: Quick-access service tiles on the Home screen. Turns light (white 80%) in dark — a source value kept as is.

tokens.name: border-border-regular
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines: dividers, text-field outline, secondary outlines. Decorative (1.1:1 light): a field also needs its fill or label to read as a field.

tokens.name: border-border-accent
tokens.usage: Focused text field outline, selected card outline.

tokens.name: border-border-negative
tokens.usage: Text field outline in the error state.

tokens.name: border-border-warning
tokens.usage: Outline of warning cards and fields.

tokens.name: border-border-positive
tokens.usage: Outline of confirmed/valid states.

tokens.name: border-border-invert
tokens.usage: Outline that separates overlapping items (stacked avatars, badges on icons).

tokens.name: chart-chart-power-on
tokens.usage: Power-outage schedule chart: hours with power.

tokens.name: chart-chart-power-off
tokens.usage: Power-outage schedule chart: hours without power.

tokens.name: chart-chart-power-possible
tokens.usage: Power-outage schedule chart: hours with a possible outage.

tokens.name: ios-label-primary
tokens.usage: From the Apple iOS kit. Labels of SegmentedControl and the dots of PageControl. Use content-content-primary everywhere else.

tokens.name: ios-fill-tertiary
tokens.usage: From the Apple iOS kit. Track of SegmentedControl.

tokens.name: ios-segmented-selected
tokens.usage: From the Apple iOS kit. Selected segment pill of SegmentedControl.

tokens.name: ios-switch-track-off
tokens.usage: From the Apple iOS kit. Track of Switch when off; on is background-bg-accent.

tokens.name: ios-platter
tokens.usage: From the Apple iOS kit. Frosted pill behind PageControl dots over images, with a 40px backdrop blur.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Rare: app name on splash, hero of the main screen. Never inside cells, cards or modals.

styles.name: large-title-emphasized
styles.usage: Bold large title, same rules as large-title.

styles.name: title1
styles.usage: Page names in the large navbar.

styles.name: title1-emphasized
styles.usage: Bold page name.

styles.name: title2
styles.usage: Section headers, bottom-sheet and modal titles. Not for body content.

styles.name: title2-emphasized
styles.usage: Bold section header.

styles.name: title3
styles.usage: Smaller section and card titles.

styles.name: title3-emphasized
styles.usage: Emphasized card title (semibold, unlike the bold Title 1–2).

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Tab labels, button labels — always a single line. Never for running text.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Оплатіть штраф до 23 жовтня, щоб уникнути пені.
styles.usage: Multi-line descriptions and paragraph content in cards. In tight cells use subheadline instead.

styles.name: body-emphasized
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Secondary text in cards, helper messages, input labels. Don't mix with body in the same zone.

styles.name: callout-emphasized
styles.usage: Emphasized callout: amounts and key values in cards.

styles.name: subheadline
styles.usage: Data-row labels, text-field values. Not as a primary label.

styles.name: subheadline-emphasized
styles.usage: Cell labels (Cell, CellSelection), emphasized secondary values and small button labels.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Timestamps, error and helper text under text fields. Not for interactive labels.

styles.name: footnote-emphasized
styles.usage: Emphasized footnote.

styles.name: caption1
styles.usage: Captions under cell labels (Cell), badges, chips, small icon labels. Never as reading text; keep the tap area 44×44. Service-grid and quick-access tiles use footnote-emphasized.

styles.name: caption1-emphasized
styles.usage: Badge counts, chip labels.

styles.name: caption2
styles.usage: Legal fine print, tab-bar labels. Smallest size; never as reading text.

styles.name: caption2-emphasized
styles.usage: Tiny emphasized labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label-to-field gap, icon-to-text gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label in buttons and toasts; gap between stacked chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of cells, text fields and toasts; gap between cells in a stack.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margin (343pt content on a 375pt screen); horizontal padding of cells, fields and toasts.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections; horizontal padding of large buttons and sheets.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large gaps: top of a screen to its first section, empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Toasts and small inner elements.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons (48px tall), cells, grouped list sections, text fields. The default radius.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Elevated cards and sheets (the elevation/regular sample).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Segmented controls, chips, switches, FAB — anything fully rounded.

tokens.name: shadow-elevation
tokens.usage: elevation/regular: the one shadow in the system, for cards on background-bg-background. Nothing else casts a shadow.

motion.note: Motion (motion.md): durations duration-*, curves ease-*, scales scale-*, each chosen by the job a motion does. Not in Figma: a proposal from the ui-motion skill. Native iOS transitions (push, sheets, alerts, menus) keep their system timing. Never one curve for everything; linear only for a spinner.

tokens.name: duration-press
tokens.usage: Press feedback (scale-press and dim), starting on pointer-down. Buttons, tiles, tappable cards.

tokens.name: duration-state
tokens.usage: A state fill set by a tap fading in and out: selected chip, row, filter. Also the crossfade that replaces travel under Reduce Motion.

tokens.name: duration-color
tokens.usage: A colour change between distant hues; longer passes through mud.

tokens.name: duration-control
tokens.usage: Switch knob, SegmentedControl and tab highlight travelling, a toast dropping in from the top.

tokens.name: duration-label
tokens.usage: A label crossfading on a control (label to spinner while waiting), the new label about 120ms behind.

tokens.name: duration-roll
tokens.usage: A status word or line rolling one full line: power status, alert and all-clear, request status.

tokens.name: duration-height
tokens.usage: A row or accordion opening or closing its height and carrying the rows below. With ease-standard.

tokens.name: duration-sheet
tokens.usage: Native-feeling responses inside the app: a custom sheet, a card growing into a screen. With ease-ios.

tokens.name: duration-travel
tokens.usage: An element flying to a new place (a chip into a list, a card into the wallet). With ease-travel.

tokens.name: duration-count
tokens.usage: One digit rolling in an amount; changed digits staggered about 45ms from the right, unchanged digits still. With ease-roll.

tokens.name: duration-stagger
tokens.usage: Step between related changes in a group, in reading order: the cause first, its results after, the toast last.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: The UI default: toggles, highlights, toasts, press feedback, anything settling into place.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Heights opening and closing: rows, accordions, filtered lists.

tokens.name: ease-travel
tokens.usage: Something moving between two stable places: soft start, clear travel, long soft arrival.

tokens.name: ease-roll
tokens.usage: Text and digits rolling like a drum: statuses, amounts.

tokens.name: ease-ios
tokens.usage: Native-feeling in-app responses over about duration-sheet: custom sheets, card-to-screen.

tokens.name: ease-throw
tokens.usage: A row or page carried on after a swipe, starting at the finger's speed.

tokens.name: ease-fade
tokens.usage: Opacity only. Transforms and sizes take the shaped curves above.

tokens.name: scale-press
tokens.usage: A pressed button, tile or card, over duration-press with ease-out.

tokens.name: scale-popover
tokens.usage: A popover or menu at rest before it opens and as it closes, scaling from the side nearest its trigger.

tokens.name: scale-lift
tokens.usage: A card carried by the finger during a drag, with a deeper shadow; it settles flat on drop.
